scope: H446 Year 13 We Do planning only
sources: previous H446 lesson and Skills development reads

policy.mapped: One primary recommendation, teacher chooses difficulty; alternatives are choices, not compulsory sequence.
policy.optional: Teacher decides; retain existing guided practice by default.
policy.phase: We Do only; retain teacher modelling, other phases, scoring and lesson content.
policy.focus: Pedagogical focus text is authoritative. proposedFocus is a candidate query value only; verify exact supported focus in app.js and browser before integration. No direct link added in this map.
policy.validation: Source-level curriculum plan from current catalogue and prior lesson reads, not a fresh full page-by-page content or runtime audit.
policy.foundations: J277 foundation links optional only; not counted as new H446 Skills.
policy.protected: Mocks, timed assessments, extended-response tasks and final readiness retained. Teacher-led feedback selects Skills from actual evidence.
